review_type: Independent source and implementation engineering review; no manuscript/conference verdict or requested disposition

confirmed_source_properties.statement: Author column median is implemented over live i, preserving [reference j,target b]; even M averages both middle values and includes self.
Only the live normalized particle receives force; reference coefficients and bandwidth are detached. create_graph=True preserves mixed derivatives through the input-gradient coefficients.

Flattening only j,b in logsumexp implements log(sum_j mean_b kernel), includes self, and retains positive repulsion with the extra 1/B; source CE is a sum of member means. This is confirmed for one whole logical batch, with no extra 1/M.

The selected-basis recurrence applies P transpose to target basis columns; after transposing it yields row_target(P^k), including k=0. Its Gram contraction is the exact fixed-P full-X inner product in real arithmetic, including cross-order terms.

Saved PolyFormer operations mix polynomial-order/hidden axes within each node, not the node axis; eval disables dropout. The saved BE wrapper is row-local and restores member-selection state in finally. A summed score VJP on selected independent token rows therefore retains per-target coefficients.

True-class raw logit and squared-norm +1e-24 agree with the pinned author raw-score path and explicit README replication epsilon choice; 1e-24 is not the author file default 1e-12. Ordinary Nesterov SGD with fresh velocity and coupled decay matches the author recurrence when applied to the declared trainable partition.

No self-node shortcut, token Euclidean metric, averaged whole-graph target gradient, truncated graph support, detached q, or changed P is introduced in the inspected FoRDE primitive. Fixed shared parameters remain differentiable maps of their inputs.

The successor correctly labels DICE as the Appendix F.2 deterministic/unit-noise CR ablation and FoRDE as an Identity/raw-logit frozen-common graph adaptation. The unadopted guarded protocol is separate and is not the main source-style force.

findings.title: The proposed all-private source-style partition has no implemented entrypoint in the inspected adapter
findings.observation: The only inspected continuation helper enables R/S at intermediate_sites; its custody names do the same. source_style_objective delegates eval mode and parameter ownership to a callback. The proposed lin1/lin2/lin3 plus all intermediate R/S partition is therefore a specification, not an executable qualified integration. Calling the existing helper silently supplies the narrower partition; calling the fresh adapter without a new helper leaves its ordinary training mode and common parameters enabled. The packet already acknowledges this gap.
findings.impact: An apparently runnable FoRDE objective can evaluate a different predictor family or active dropout unless the caller resolves the gap. It cannot establish the proposed source-style control from the inspected code alone.
findings.remedy: Prepare a distinct source-style setup wrapper in a successor: clear all grads, freeze all parameters, enable only every existing site_names R/S tensor, set all modules to eval, enumerate exact trainable names and optimizer membership, and assert disjoint frozen/common ownership. Use the existing finally-based member-selection restoration. Qualify all-one native equality, complete member trajectories, selected-row equality and live input/mixed-private derivatives before declaring the runner usable.
findings.not_claimed: No predecessor was changed and no actual configured run was observed.

findings.title: Shape checks cannot bind a Gram tensor to the selected native token rows
findings.observation: native_row_grams returns a plain tensor. source_style_objective receives tokens, labels and grams without target IDs, power/operator fingerprint or token-cache identity. normalize_full_feature_coefficients checks only B/L shape, dtype/device and requires_grad. A valid same-shaped G from a different target ordering, P or polynomial bank is silently accepted. The JSON requires full-graph cache identity but this enforcement is not implemented in the inspected primitive.
findings.impact: A positional mismatch changes the full-feature norm, distance, bandwidth and private force while all current local shape guards can succeed. Tensor requires_grad=False is also not an immutability guarantee.
findings.remedy: Add a qualified orchestration descriptor binding ordered target IDs, exact native COO representation/operator identity, K/base, feature/token bank identity, dtype/device and precision receipt to G. Derive CE labels and token rows from the same ordered IDs; verify the descriptor before objective evaluation and invalidate G on any dependency change. Keep P/G outside optimizers and qualify nonmutating custody. Add a synthetic deliberately swapped-order/operator witness to the orchestration gate.
findings.not_claimed: The algebraic primitive is correct when its documented inputs are correctly bound; no mismatched live cache was inspected.

findings.title: Exact Gram algebra still needs a condition-sensitive force qualification
findings.observation: The Gram quadratic forms are mathematically PSD but are evaluated using float32 bmm/einsum with different accumulation order from direct sum-of-squares pullback. Signed coefficients can cancel across correlated polynomial rows. Singular or nearly singular G can yield a tiny represented full-X gradient despite large coefficient terms; float32 error then changes normalization with its 1e-24 squared-norm stabilizer and can produce a negative quadratic that deliberately aborts. h near its 1e-12 floor and median ties can amplify downstream differences. No numeric tolerances, error measurements or native mixed-backward receipts exist. O5 already includes identity P and small gradients, but does not spell out coefficient cancellation/conditioning or backend precision policy.
findings.impact: Value agreement in a benign fixture does not certify normalized distances, bandwidths and mixed-private forces at native cancellation regimes. Failure-on-negative is appropriately explicit, but its frequency and fallback feasibility are unknown.
findings.remedy: Before numerical use, freeze tolerances and record direct-versus-Gram errors separately for g/norm, normalized distances, h, log-KDE and mixed-private gradients. Include singular/near-dependent row powers with opposing signed coefficients, zero/tiny full-X norms, duplicate directions, floor-dominated bandwidth and median ties, besides nonsymmetric/duplicate COO and ReLU-away-from-kink cases. Bind autocast and float32 matmul/TF32 settings, sparse transpose behavior, device and versions. Inspect cancellation ratios and norm regimes. Retain qualified direct pullback or stop if the adopted tolerance cannot be met; any dtype, clamp or metric change would require a named successor choice.
findings.not_claimed: No negative value, autograd failure or tolerance violation was numerically observed in this review.

findings.title: The warm-bank contract does not yet exclude a symmetry-collapsed FoRDE start
findings.observation: The prepared BE adapter initializes every member R/S to one. The pinned FoRDE author initializes members with separate PRNG subkeys. If a prospective deterministic shared warm procedure preserves identical members, all input-gradient directions coincide and every first-argument distance gradient is zero. FoRDE has no repulsive mechanism to leave exact symmetry; CE and equal factor decay preserve it. The packet requires a competent warm receipt but gives no predeclared symmetry-breaking construction or directional-collapse diagnostic. Actual warm values were not read.
findings.impact: A competent but collapsed shared warm bank can yield a FoRDE control with identically zero diversity force, while DICE instance noise can produce asymmetric stochastic updates. This would materially affect the comparison within the restricted family.
findings.remedy: Bind the warm acquisition and member symmetry-breaking rule prospectively and copy the resulting bank identically across arms. Before comparison, record parameter/member equality, raw-gradient norm/direction collapse, and whether intended private sites have usable mixed-force sensitivity; distinguish zero gradients from coincident directions. If collapse is part of the chosen protocol, label and interpret it explicitly rather than treating it as evidence about general FoRDE.
findings.not_claimed: The existing or future warm bank is not asserted to be collapsed; this is an unexcluded source-level risk.

findings.title: The source force requires one declared logical batch across chunks or devices
findings.observation: The prepared objective correctly uses its entire distance target axis as B. The pinned source all-gathers targets, divides get_repulsive_term by local batch_size, slices the local cotangent, and pmeans parameter gradients; the predecessor explicitly confined qualification to a single-device B=128. The new standalone JSON does not restate a device policy or global/local B mapping. Independent per-chunk or per-device objectives would change the inside-log mixture and force. Final partial B is intentionally used here, but the bound author dataset loader was not retrieved, so original partial-batch emission is not established.
findings.impact: Changing B to fit memory or applying an additional distributed average can weaken/strengthen repulsion, including the potentially large final-partial-batch 1/B effect. This is an execution gap, not an error in the current whole-logical-batch formula.
findings.remedy: State single-device whole-logical-batch scope explicitly until an equivalent distributed implementation is qualified. For chunks/two-pass execution, compute global reference values, h and log-KDE/cotangent once over the declared B and preserve that force during live recomputation. For multiple devices, derive and verify gather/VJP/gradient-reduction scaling against the single logical batch. Freeze and charge the last-batch policy with actual B.
findings.not_claimed: No distributed or chunked implementation was executed or found in this packet.

findings.title: Source parsing is not a native runtime, competence or resource receipt
findings.observation: All source-force, row-locality, mixed-autograd, native composition, warm, DICE learning/state, optimizer schedule/duration, checkpoint selector and real-shape resource gates remain unexecuted or unbound. The prepared FoRDE primitive has no learner runner, optimizer setup or completed-cycle checkpoint integration. The resource formulas are illustrative and correct at the stated leading-order level; they do not establish feasibility of full TRAIN Gram preparation or mixed-backward cycles.
findings.impact: The material is suitable for preparing a future qualification runner, but it cannot yet supply a competent executed graph comparator. This is expressly disclosed by the packet.
findings.remedy: Complete the source integration and identity binding, then obtain the separately authorized static/numerical receipts, exact names/ownership, ordinary runtime/precision receipt and predeclared graph-qualified optimizer, duration and validation checkpoint rule. Profile actual token residency, cold and reused Gram cache preparation over all intended targets, full mixed-backward peak memory/time, and DICE partner/auxiliary costs; bind a resource budget. No comparison outcome can substitute for these missing receipts.
findings.not_claimed: This review creates no adoption, fit, numerical or launch authority.

scope_limitations: Frozen common maps with trainable existing R/S only define a restricted shared BE family. Even all-affine R/S training is not independently trainable full source networks.
DICE unit-noise CR omits the full DICE VCEB scale heads, backward embeddings and compression/sampled classifier objective; no DICE author implementation was retrieved.

FoRDE Identity omits PCA/data lengthscale choices. The pinned author uses training-mode ResNet BatchNorm; its summed-score input VJP is not a generic per-example Jacobian for batch-coupled networks. This graph adaptation depends on actual node-local eval composition.
Reference-column bandwidths make K generally asymmetric; preserve this author-code behavior without importing a symmetric-PSD-kernel or posterior guarantee.
Primary softmax(mean raw logits) differs from author mean softmax probabilities. The proposed same-logit secondary endpoint discloses the adaptation; full source claims remain unavailable.

The existing intermediate-only guarded continuation remains a separately named, more restricted scientific control with candidate-specific feasibility restrictions. Its result cannot be called full DICE/FoRDE competence.

Bind warm construction/symmetry policy, logical B, ordinary runtime and precision controls
After separate authorization, qualify source-axis/stop-gradients/scale, row locality, direct pullback/Gram and native mixed derivatives
Bind competence-qualified schedule/duration/selector and actual resource receipts before any comparison
